situationTags.fil: Hinarang ako ng pulis at hinahawakan ang aking katawan
situationTags.en: Police stopped me and is patting me down

situationTags.fil: Hinihalughog ang aking bag o damit ng pulis sa kalye
situationTags.en: Police searching my bag or clothing on the street

right.fil: Ang pulis ay maaaring huminto at mag-frisk (maghanap) sa iyong ibabaw ng damit kung may makatwirang dahilan silang maniwala na ikaw ay may hawak na sandata — ngunit kailangan silang magpaliwanag ng konkretong dahilan.
right.en: Police may stop and frisk (pat down) you if they have reasonable suspicion you are carrying a weapon — but they must be able to articulate a concrete reason.

whatThisMeans.fil: Ang stop-and-frisk o Terry stop ay pinahihintulutan sa ilalim ng Philippine jurisprudence kapag may 'reasonable suspicion' — isang konkretong, articulated na paniniwalang ikaw ay may hawak na sandata o gagawa ng krimen. Hindi sapat ang hula, kutob, o 'mukha kang suspetsoso.' Limitado lamang ito sa panlabas na halughog ng damit para sa sandata — hindi ito lisensya para maghanap ng droga o ibang bagay.
whatThisMeans.en: Stop-and-frisk (Terry stop) is permitted under Philippine jurisprudence only when there is 'reasonable suspicion' — a concrete, articulable belief that you are carrying a weapon or about to commit a crime. A hunch, gut feeling, or 'you look suspicious' is not enough. It is limited to a pat-down of outer clothing for weapons — not a license to search for drugs or other items.

theyCannot.fil: Mag-frisk sayo base sa hitsura, kulay ng balat, o lugar lang.
theyCannot.en: Frisk you based on appearance, skin color, or location alone.

theyCannot.fil: Buksan ang iyong bag o kilusan ang iyong mga gamit nang walang iyong pahintulot o warrant.
theyCannot.en: Open your bag or go through your belongings without your consent or a warrant.

theyCannot.fil: Gumamit ng stop-and-frisk para makita ang droga o ibang bawal na bagay — hanggang sandata lang ang pinahihintulutang hinahanap.
theyCannot.en: Use stop-and-frisk to look for drugs or other contraband — only weapons are the permitted target.

youCan.fil: Tanungin: 'Bakit ninyo ako hinihinto? Ano ang konkretong dahilan ninyo?'
youCan.en: Ask: 'Why are you stopping me? What is your specific reason?'

youCan.fil: Sabihing hindi ka pumapayag sa paghahalughog ng iyong bag.
youCan.en: State that you do not consent to a search of your bag.

youCan.fil: Tandaan ang pangalan at badge number ng opisyal.
youCan.en: Note the officer's name and badge number.

youCan.fil: Magreklamo sa PNP Internal Affairs o CHR kung walang makatwirang dahilan ang frisk.
youCan.en: Complain to PNP Internal Affairs or CHR if the frisk had no articulable reason.

eli5.fil: Puwede kang ihinto ng pulis para tingnan kung may baril o kutsilyo ka — ngunit kailangan nilang may totoong dahilan, hindi lang kutob. Hindi rin nila puwedeng buksan ang iyong bag kung wala kang pahintulot.
eli5.en: Police can stop you to check for a gun or knife — but they need a real reason, not just a feeling. They also can't open your bag without your permission.

scopeNotes.fil: Ang Philippine jurisprudence (hal. People v. Cogaed, 2014) ay nagpapalit-ng-tuntunin sa stop-and-frisk. Ang mga detalye ay maaaring magbago depende sa sitwasyon. Para sa mga kaso na may kinalaman sa iyong partikular na sitwasyon, kumonsulta sa abogado.
scopeNotes.en: Philippine jurisprudence (e.g., People v. Cogaed, 2014) has refined the stop-and-frisk rules. Specifics may vary by situation. For cases involving your particular circumstances, consult a lawyer.

label.fil: Saligang Batas 1987, Artikulo III, Section 2 — Karapatan laban sa Hindi Makatwirang Paghahalughog
label.en: 1987 Constitution, Article III, Section 2 — Right Against Unreasonable Searches

citations.quotedText: The right of the people to be secure in their persons, houses, papers, and effects against unreasonable searches and seizures of whatever nature and for any purpose shall be inviolable, and no search warrant or warrant of arrest shall issue except upon probable cause to be determined personally by the judge...
